prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `Version::parse` in src/lib.rs for strings of exactly three dot-separated non-negative integers, for example `1.2.3`. Reject missing or extra components, empty components, non-digits, and leading zeros such as `01.2.3` (a single `0` is fine). Ordering is the derived tuple order. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
